notes: All cases load original gm mode0 through the production UI adapter and replay original Save1 destinations with public TryMove. No Solve/preview, ApplyHint, fabricated switch/water state, proxy target count, or direct transform placement is used. Screen picking and drag motion are covered by the separate interaction validation.

A same-cell drag first verifies the original guide equals the recorded drop. If its real support moves during released settling, final placement is checked against that production Motion.Target (original support transform+4.2), with both recorded destination and dynamic target logged. No actor coordinates, switches, collision tolerance or water target standards are changed.

Recovery.MoveCount counts successful undoable transactions, including a legal same-cell pickup/release. The original game has no visible player MoveCount field; this internal recovery counter is not presented as native UI scoring.
609 must fill four real moving CuFuente targets; 622 must fill two. st9 preview actors are forbidden in every case. A legal 0/0 final preview is not gameplay completion.

Native doSolucionLevel clears chequearFuentes while in preview (101FEC8). Native ControladorJuego.Update polls numFuentes>=requiredFuentes after counter reaches 51. Actual wet/completion frame timings are observed after all recorded steps, without requiring 51 consecutive wet frames as an original rule.

Save1 z skips actor capture in doProcess1Solution. Same-cell non-z actions with an actual movable capture execute production pickup/release, including the native layer2/12 cycle; empty capture same-position markers remain legal no-ops. w enables the original wait before its real pickup. r has a +1.2 Y adjustment only in HandleSolutionTotal; normal player placement uses the native pressure-plate grid height. Original a/b/c/d codes alter transient preview lift rather than the player's destination.

Simulation runs at Time.timeScale=10; every player placement allows at least .18 real seconds for the water network (unscaled .12-second cadence), then waits for real mechanism motion to settle. Water propagation is allowed to continue between moves. Final validation waits up to120 real seconds and requires HasPendingPropagation=false in addition to real positive matching-color targets, settled mechanisms and the production51-frame completion poll. Original imported timeScale4 is restored.
